```{=html}
<style>
.w064 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w064 .w064-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w064 .w064-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w064 .w064-row.w064-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w064 .w064-row.w064-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w064 .w064-txt { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w064 .w064-tf { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.w064 .w064-tf button {
  padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w064 .w064-tf button.w064-on { background: #d81e2e; border-color: #d81e2e; color: #fff; }
.w064 .w064-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w064 .w064-controls > button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w064 .w064-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w064 .w064-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w064 .w064-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w064 .w064-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w064 .w064-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style>
<div class="w064 iw" id="w064">
  <div class="w064-list" aria-label="statements to judge"></div>
  <div class="w064-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w064-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w064-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w064-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w064-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w064-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w064-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    TLS 1.2 is the minimum and 1.0/1.1 are disabled, because a downgrade undoes the protection; certificates must be kept valid; and in the cloud the private keys belong in a managed key store, not in a file beside the application. TLS protects data in motion between endpoints only &mdash; not the same data at rest or in use on the server &mdash; and a deep-packet-inspecting firewall sees only ciphertext, which TLS inspection restores at the price of breaking end-to-end confidentiality at one trusted point &mdash; see <a href="#sec-06-tls">the section on TLS</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w064');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w064-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w064-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w064-expl');
  const ITEMS = [
    ['TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are disabled in a hardened deployment; TLS 1.2 is the minimum.', 't'],
    ['An expired certificate breaks the service as surely as a misconfiguration.', 't'],
    ['In the cloud, the private key behind a certificate is best kept in a file beside the application.', 'f'],
    ['TLS also protects the same data once it sits decrypted on the server.', 'f'],
    ['A firewall performing deep packet inspection sees only ciphertext inside a TLS connection.', 't'],
    ['TLS inspection (break-and-inspect) restores inspection at no cost to end-to-end confidentiality.', 'f']
  ];

  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w064-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w064-right', 'w064-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w064-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function select(row, val) {
    row.dataset.sel = val;
    [...row.querySelectorAll('.w064-tf button')].forEach(b => {
      b.classList.toggle('w064-on', b.dataset.val === val);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.dataset.val === val ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }
  ITEMS.forEach(it => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w064-row';
    row.dataset.a = it[1];
    row.dataset.sel = '';
    const txt = document.createElement('span');
    txt.className = 'w064-txt';
    txt.textContent = it[0];
    const tf = document.createElement('span');
    tf.className = 'w064-tf';
    [['t', 'True'], ['f', 'False']].forEach(v => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button';
      b.dataset.val = v[0];
      b.textContent = v[1];
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        select(row, row.dataset.sel === v[0] ? '' : v[0]);
        clearMarks();
      });
      tf.appendChild(b);
    });
    row.appendChild(txt); row.appendChild(tf);
    list.appendChild(row);
  });
  root.querySelector('.w064-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, unanswered = 0;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w064-row').forEach(r => {
      r.classList.remove('w064-right', 'w064-wrong');
      if (!r.dataset.sel) { unanswered++; return; }
      if (r.dataset.sel === r.dataset.a) { r.classList.add('w064-right'); right++; }
      else r.classList.add('w064-wrong');
    });
    if (right === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - encrypting the channel is necessary, not sufficient.'; msg.className = 'w064-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (unanswered > 0 && right + unanswered === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going - ' + unanswered + ' statement(s) still unanswered.'; msg.className = 'w064-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - ' + right + ' of ' + ITEMS.length + ' statements are right; rethink the red ones.'; msg.className = 'w064-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w064-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w064-row').forEach(r => select(r, ''));
    clearMarks();
    expl.hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w064-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w064-row').forEach(r => {
      select(r, r.dataset.a);
      r.classList.remove('w064-wrong'); r.classList.add('w064-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w064-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
```
